name: Sumadhura Solace
location: Marathahalli Main Road, Thubarahalli, East Bengaluru
tagline: The rarest element in luxury living
overview: An 11.66-acre development of 7 architecturally refined towers (2 basements + Ground + 18 floors) with 777 exclusive residences, set beside twin lakes on Marathahalli Main Road, Thubarahalli. 81% of the development is open space and landscaped avenues, anchored by a full-scale clubhouse and 90+ amenities.
highlights: 11.66 acres with 81% open space and landscaped avenues
7 architecturally refined towers, 2 Basement + G + 18 floors
777 exclusive residences with ample car parking
Surrounded by twin lakes for a naturally serene setting
90+ amenities across a dedicated clubhouse and landscaped zones
5 towers of residences: Sora, Vana, Nira, Kora, plus Luma, Mira, Olea
amenities: Clubhouse with co-working spaces & AV lounge
Half basketball court, tennis court & pickle ball court
Outdoor gym & calisthenics zone on EPDM
Multi-use kids play areas (2-8 yrs & 8+ yrs)
Pet park with pet grooming area
Reflexology pathway, zen garden & nature trail

items: Core wall and shear wall monolithic construction using Aluminum Modular shuttering system
Main door: premium timber frame & shutter with quality ironmongery
Aluminum sliding doors/windows with clear glass and mosquito mesh
MS safety grills provided
Italian marble in entrance lobby & clubhouse lounge
Imported marble or laminated wooden flooring in master bedroom
Vitrified tile / marble flooring in living, dining & kitchen
Vitrified tile flooring in all bedrooms, toilets and balconies
Weather-resistant exterior emulsion, two coats
Premium emulsion on internal walls, acrylic emulsion on ceilings
Concealed copper wiring (Havells/Polycab or equivalent)
Modular switches (Panasonic/Schneider or equivalent)
Home automation provision in living room & master bedroom
AC power socket provision in all bedrooms and living room
100% DG power backup for lifts, pumps & common lighting
Wall-mounted EWC with concealed flush tank
Sanitary ware of TOTO/Grohe or equivalent
Individual water meters for each flat
Round-the-clock security, panic buttons, intercom in lifts
High-speed lifts with auto rescue device (Schindler or equivalent)
Fire sprinklers, hydrants, extinguishers and alarm system on all floors
Softened water via exclusive Water Treatment Plant
Sewage Treatment Plant with treated water reused for landscaping/flushing
Rainwater harvesting tanks and recharge wells
Organic waste converters

locationInfo.summary: Situated on Marathahalli Main Road, Thubarahalli, offering connectivity to prime IT hubs, reputed schools, major hospitals and metro access in East Bengaluru.
